routines.edgeAssessment: Mixed signs, negative radius, unrestricted angles/longitudes, axes/origin/poles and scaled magnitudes distinguish input ordering and normalization. Focused tests supplement the live comparisons with scaled tiny/huge radii, complete conversion workflows, retained output ownership and input nonmutation. For cyllat/cylsph/reccyl, the focused live overflow test explicitly compares signed maximum-double inputs and finite recovery controls against locked SpiceyPy via scoped JSON-safe nonfinite classification; the ordinary workflow JSON cannot carry Infinity.
routines.errorAssessment: NAIF documents these routines as error-free for proper inputs. No fabricated scientific error scenario. TypeScript-specific finite scalar and exact finite vector validation is tested on both real backends, including subsequent recovery. Finite input can produce norm overflow; no extra finite-output restriction redefines CSPICE.
routines.fixtureRationale: Authored mathematical coordinates only; no kernel data, file formats, distribution or external-fixture dependency.
routines.cleanup: Shared shim writes local results into caller output only after checking SPICE status, uses standard capture/reset on errors and no heap ownership. WASM withAllocs frees two buffers per scalar conversion or three for reccyl on success and every allocation failure; returned triples/objects are copies. Native uses stack arrays and existing global mutex. Actual fault tests prove cleanup and recovery; backend tests dispose in finally.
routines.tolerance: Existing 1e-12 absolute-or-relative live comparator remains unchanged. All ordinary nonzero asymmetric outputs distinguish swapped fields. Focused scaled-radius assertions divide tiny/huge actual magnitudes by their known scale to avoid the absolute tolerance hiding zero; roundtrips and numeric invariants supplement the independent oracle, not replace it. JavaScript/libm angle assertions allow documented small floating differences.

findings.summary: The adapters validated caller-owned numeric arrays and then read them again while dispatching or marshaling. These later reads could differ from the checked values.
findings.repair: Copy the three validated rectangular components once into an owned tuple; dispatch the tuple to native or WASM. Scalar-input coordinate routines are unchanged. The focused public boundary regression compares single-read inputs with ordinary arrays on both real backends; unchanged registered cases retain the independent scientific oracle.
